class.name: SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult
class.brief_description: Order receipt or a recoverable checkout failure.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a typed response for the commerce adapter. Echo the original checkout ID on a successful begin response. Error results can carry the same ID for retry.

members.member: The confirmed order receipt on success. A recoverable error can also carry an existing order whose state is [constant SteamPurchaseOutcome.RECONCILING].
Stable retry ID when the result belongs to a submitted cart. Retained when the local observer times out or closes.
